title: Expectancy in 15 seconds
hook: Got an edge? One number answers that.
takeaway: Expectancy is what you make or lose per trade, on average. In R: add up every result and divide by the number of trades. Above zero, you have an edge; below zero, you don't.
learn: Expectancy is what you make or lose per trade, on average.
To get it in R, add up every trade's result and divide by the number of trades: +3.5R over 20 trades is +0.18R.
Above zero means you have an edge; below zero means you don't.
